title: Move TextContent/TextSegment out of text_cache_repository.dart (data layer) into domain/entities/ so presentation and its tests stop importing the data layer
rule: Presentation→data import ban [P]; naming/placement (domain models belong in domain/); Evans lens (bounded-context leak)
why: TextContent/TextSegment are plain immutable data holders — exactly what domain/entities/ is for (that directory exists, scaffolded with a lone .gitkeep, but was never populated) — yet they are defined at the top of text_cache_repository.dart, the DATA-layer repository implementation. That forces text_display_screen.dart (presentation, and a churn HOTSPOT at 1028 lines) to import the data layer just to type its own widget fields (_TextContentView.textContent, _NumberedSegmentColumn.segments). It then forces every test that builds fixture content — 3 of this batch's files (text_display_screen_test.dart, _l1_test.dart, _deep_l1_test.dart) — to do the same, so the test suite faithfully pins the wrong layering instead of catching it. Concrete cost: a presentation test can't get a TextContent value without also pulling in TextCacheRepository's own Drift-DAO-typed constructor surface (the seam Feathers-style testability depends on is gone); a different feature that wanted to render cached text would have to import a repository class to get the model type; and this is a same-feature leak, so it isn't caught by make audit's Rule 1/2 greps (which are scoped to cross-feature imports).
recommendation: Create lib/features/content_browsing/domain/entities/text_content.dart holding TextContent/TextSegment (mechanical move, no behavior change). Update text_cache_repository.dart and text_display_screen.dart (+ its tests) to import the new domain file instead of the repository file.
acceptance_criteria: text_display_screen_l1_test.dart, _deep_l1_test.dart, and text_display_screen_test.dart import domain/entities/text_content.dart, not data/repositories/text_cache_repository.dart, and still pass.
